adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the code falls back to searching destinationCalendar for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (which is undefined). This will never find a match since no calendar has externalId === undefined, so selectedCalendar becomes undefined. This is passed to the Google API which may cause issues. The same bug pattern appears in deleteEvent at lines 314-316. This is a real logic error in the fallback condition.
